Our Story

Started in a garage roaster in 2014. Still just as obsessed.

Riverside Roasters started as a single 1-kilo roaster in a garage, run by two friends who couldn't find a coffee they actually loved in town. Ten years later we're roasting several batches a week, all cupped and dialed in by hand before anything reaches a customer.

We still buy from the same three farm partners we started with, pay well above commodity price, and visit the farms ourselves when we can. If a bag says single-origin, we can tell you exactly whose farm it came from.

1. 2013

    A cart

    One cart, one grinder, outside the station, in the rain more often than not.

  2. 2016

    The shop

    Twelve seats and a roaster in the back that was too big for the room.

  3. 2020

    Roasting for others

    Other cafés started asking for our beans, which we had not planned for at all.

  4. Today

    Still twelve seats

    We looked at bigger rooms twice and decided against it both times.
